description: This file manages plugin key-value storage operations in the Mattermost server, including setting, getting, deleting, and listing plugin keys, with support for hashed keys and expiration.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods for plugin key-value operations.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Server struct with method for retrieving plugin keys using hashed keys.

methods.name: getKeyHash
methods.description: Generates a SHA256 hash of the key and encodes it in base64.

methods.name: SetPluginKey
methods.description: Sets a plugin key with no expiration.

methods.name: SetPluginKeyWithExpiry
methods.description: Sets a plugin key with an expiration time.

methods.name: CompareAndSetPluginKey
methods.description: Atomically compares and sets a plugin key's value.

methods.name: SetPluginKeyWithOptions
methods.description: Sets a plugin key with specific options, including atomicity and old value check.

methods.name: CompareAndDeletePluginKey
methods.description: Deletes a plugin key if its current value matches the provided old value.

methods.name: getPluginKey
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin key's value, checking both plain and hashed keys.

methods.name: GetPluginKey
methods.description: Public method to get a plugin key's value.

methods.name: DeleteAllKeysForPlugin
methods.description: Deletes all keys associated with a plugin.
